main.description: Promote a pending reservation to confirmed and emit ADR-0028 resource-flow records (legalEntityCurrencyFlow + legalEntityServiceFlow). Idempotent on (reservationId, status=confirmed). Owner-only or holding actor with confirmation grant. Tier-3 raw amount stays caller-side; the emitted flow record carries the bucketed amount and the chain counterparty DID resolved from the hotel.

amountJpy.description: Optional caller-side raw amount used to refine the bucket. Tier 3 — never persisted as raw.

fiscalPeriod.description: ISO 8601 period for the emitted flow (defaults to the YYYY-MM of checkin).

errors.name: InvalidState
errors.description: status が pending 以外 (cancelled / completed)

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: caller がオーナーでも confirmation grant 保持者でもない
